findings.evidence: REDLOG rlqe web documentation;QEPCAD pinned EnterForm/Lifting/Solution
findings.observation: Existing real-algebra QE accepts quantified polynomial formulas and can return exact quantifier-free sets;for exact algebraic-analytic branches and centre the full moving-witness limit formula is a baseline contract. This is expressibility,not a locally executed independent judge.
findings.boundary: Arbitrary analytic coefficients are not thereby rational-polynomial inputs. Preserve branch/domain encodings and every epsilon/delta/witness quantifier;do not reuse the jet adapter in the reference.

findings.evidence: https://www.redlog.eu/documentation/service.php?key=rlqe web body actually read;historical manual rlgqe primary search excerpt only
findings.observation: rlqe correctness with assumptions is conditional on those assumptions. Virtual substitution has a degree restriction and normally combines with partial CAD;disabling fallback can leave quantifiers. Generic elimination extends assumptions in the historical manual excerpt.
findings.boundary: Do not accept residual quantified output as QF or remove exceptional centres by unexamined assumptions. Current rlgqe service body was inaccessible;the author-manual PDF failed hostname verification. No modern generic implementation was audited.

findings.observation: solution-extension T can add projection factors to return a Tarski formula;E returns indexed-root extended language;F deliberately ignores lower-dimensional cells. Lifting documentation describes truth on all cells.
findings.boundary: F-mode or sample-point equality alone is not full set equivalence. A comparison through symmetric-difference QE must preserve lower-dimensional and exceptional strata;no such computation was run.

findings.observation: Variable order,degree,formula splitting and projection choices matter. The projection page explicitly labels itself out of date and describes a possible-error/restart path. Regression README warns textually different formulas may be equivalent. Seven selected regression input blocks use ordinary quantified polynomial formulas.
findings.boundary: The pinned repository revision is not a claim to a newly released binary. Historical projection advice is not verified current branch behaviour. Charge order search,retries,solution construction and exact equivalence checking;no solver or regression was executed. F/G quantifiers do not automatically express t approaching zero.

findings.evidence: RAGlib author homepage and distribution page,entire web bodies read
findings.observation: Documented interfaces decide real feasibility and sample each connected component of polynomial systems. The author distribution page lists release3.4(December2017),Maple/FGb prerequisites and older mixed-system genericity warnings.
findings.boundary: The dated release page is not a live installation report or assurance all old genericity restrictions persist in3.4. The selected page does not supply joint-limit or sufficient-jet-order certificates. No Maple/FGb/RAGlib install or execution.

findings.observation: An actual RAGlib consumer samples non-vanishing determinant regions for parametric real-root classification,including camera P3P. Problem1 requires a dense union of regions,not all parameter points. Algorithm2 explicitly excludes w_infinity=0 and minors=0;correctness also assumes a good randomly selected rational basis change.
findings.boundary: Generically nonempty finite complex fibres are required;regular-sequence/Assumption2 additionally serve complexity,while the practical implementation says it uses only Assumption1. Do not mistake root counts/chambers or this dense-region output for an exact joint upper-limit set,or claim that all boundary data are supplied.

findings.observation: The authors separately report Hermite matrices,minors,determinants and sample-point times on Xeon6244 with1.5TB RAM. In the general5parameter P3P example,computing sample points outside the discriminant is explicitly a further step.
findings.boundary: Published timings concern another algorithm/task/platform,not APP05801 full cost or local replication. Do not call determinant generation full classification or borrow those speedups. Adaptive Puiseux/Newton and certified Taylor remain unimplemented comparison obligations,not measured losers.
